propositions: Operators force-close ~25 of 33 administrative-disposition tickets (duplicate/obsolete/superseded/wontfix) because completion verification cannot pass them and the truthful exit path is undiscoverable from failure messages
Current close-class vocabulary (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) is artificially limited; obsolete/superseded/wontfix are needed and must be available for non-bug ticket types (task/story/epic)

Administrative closes with reason-required classes (obsolete/wontfix) must persist the reason present-only as close_reason (distinct from force_close_reason) and skip completion/AC/billable verification while producing signed disposition attestations
Close-precheck failure messages must enumerate the applicable --class values for each ticket type so operators discover the administrative disposition exit

Replacement-bearing classes (duplicate/superseded) must demand a live replacement link; reason-only classes (obsolete/wontfix) must demand a reason supplied via existing --reason flag admitted without --force
